assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area boundaries are provisional repository geometry (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-RESEARCH-001) inferred from the official announcement's textual extent; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, and control values derived from these boundaries are provisional planning indicators for review, not statutory or approval values.

assumptions.statement: The five land-use categories (park-green, youth commons, Dazhongsi cultural core, campus-adjacent co-creation, Xiaoyue River living band) are a conceptual program structure proposed by the design, not an approved land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Land-use proportions are design intent to be coordinated with the approved regulatory detailed plan; no land-use approval is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints and floor-area indicators are indicative massing studies for the AI youth commons program; exact FAR, height, setback and density controls remain subject to official control conditions.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area and related density metrics are design evidence only and are not binding development intensity values.

assumptions.statement: Green-space and public-space nodes (including the Xiaoyue River waterfront band and the blue-green youth ring) are conceptual improvements that must respect existing green lines, blue lines and heritage protection zones.
assumptions.impact: Green/public ratios are concept-level targets; final configuration requires detailed municipal and heritage review.

assumptions.statement: The AI cultural guide scenario and operation proposals assume publicly available AI services and non-intrusive, human-reviewable urban service scenarios; no private data or unauthorized branding is used.
assumptions.impact: Operation scenarios are illustrative; procurement, data governance and liability arrangements are out of scope for this submission.
